subject: Discovery recap + suspected model delta — request for investigation and temporary pin
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@peregrine.io>
Cc: Claire Turner <claire.turner@trellisfin.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 19 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery recap + initial fit recommendations (Peregrine)

Hi Samir / Claire — great to meet earlier. Quick recap from today's discovery and next steps I promised: 

Summary of needs
- Primary workload: structured transaction classification + short-form entity extraction for payments ops
- Latency requirement: p95 < 180ms for single-turn classification
- Accuracy: target macro-F1 >= 0.92 on Peregrine holdout set

Initial model recommendations
- redwood-open-7b-q8: best balance of latency/cost for your traffic profile
- redwood-legal-3.1: fallback for high-risk submissions (higher recall on entity edge cases)

Artifacts attached / links
- prompt-set-v2.txt (attached) — canonical prompts and negative examples
- eval-results.csv (attached) — baseline metrics from our demo run (seeded with your sample corpus)
- Benchmark report: https://redwood.app/benchmarks/peregrine-20261219

Open items / asks for Peregrine
1) Can you share 200-500 recent production queries with labels we can use for a blind eval?
2) Any compliance constraints around data residency (we flagged EU-only for one of your teams)

One thing flagged during the demo run: we saw a small but consistent delta (drop in precision for a specific payment type) compared to the baseline run we saved two weeks ago. I don't want to alarm you — it may be prompt drift — but I wanted to surface it now since your production window is tight. If you see anything on your side please send examples.

Next steps (proposed)
- Peregrine: share 300 labelled rows by EOD Tue 12/22
- Redwood: run a focused regression diff against the saved baseline and propose either a pin or short-term fallback model by 12/20 (ETA below)

Attaching eval-results.csv and prompt-set-v2.txt for reference. I'll circle back to ops with a plan if we confirm a regression.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Account Exec — Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415 555 0198

Attachments: eval-results.csv (CSV, 2MB); prompt-set-v2.txt (TXT, 18KB)

From: Samir Patel <samir@peregrine.io>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claire Turner <claire.turner@trellisfin.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Dec 2026 18:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + initial fit recommendations (Peregrine)

Diego — thanks for the thorough recap and the artifacts. Quick follow-up from our engineering team after a short sanity-run against our nightly stream:

- We observed a noticeable drop in precision on the "ACH-credit" label starting at 12/07 (approx), compared to the run you shared. False positives jumped from ~3.4% to ~7.9% on a 1k sample.
- I'm attaching three representative examples (inlined below) where the model over-attributes the ACH-credit tag. These came from production queries — low-latency path.

Examples (redacted):
1) "Payment to vendor — ACH credit — ref 8821" -> model returned ACH-credit + Vendor-Transfer (should be only ACH-credit)
2) "Customer refund via ACH" -> model returned Refund + ACH-debit (incorrect polarity)
3) "Payroll run: ACH credit scheduled" -> model returned ACH-credit but extracted payee incorrectly in 2/3 cases

This is time-sensitive — our ops team noticed increased workflow friction. If you can check whether a model variant or a recent runtime kernel change might be the cause that would help. We need either a rollback/pin or a fallback plan while we triage.

- Samir (on behalf of Peregrine Tech)
Senior Engineering Manager
Peregrine Financial

Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Discovery recap + suspected model delta — Peregrine asks for rollback/pin

Team — forwarding Peregrine's note. TL;DR: Samir reported a precision regression on ACH-credit around 12/07. They provided 3 representative examples and we have the original baseline run attached.

Please treat as priority for the sales SLT for this deal (RWF-2026-088). Asks: 
- Marissa: can you run a regression diff against the saved baseline from 11/29 and the most recent prod snapshot? I attached compare-diffs.json from an initial quick run — it's small but shows token-level divergence on a handful of cases.
- Aditya: please confirm whether any runtime kernel updates or quantization-profile rollouts went live between 12/05-12/10 for redwood-open-7b-q8 in prod that could affect classification polarity.
- Monica: if we confirm a regression, propose a pining/rollback plan (recommended: pin customer to redwood-open-7b-q8@v3.0.9 or failover to redwood-legal-3.1 for high-risk flows). Need ETA for pin (how long to stage & apply per-customer pin) and communication text for Peregrine.

Proposed customer comms once we have TIP (triage-impact-plan): 
- Short note acknowledging receipt, summary of immediate mitigation (pin or fallback), ETA for triage results (4-6 hours), and plan for permanent fix (post-mortem + regression tests).

Attachments: compare-diffs.json (JSON, 45KB)

Diego
Account Exec — Redwood Inference

Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Discovery recap + suspected model delta — Peregrine asks for rollback/pin

Thanks Diego — I ran a quick pass on the compare-diffs you attached. High-level: there are 18 cases with divergent labels out of the 1k sample we re-ran; the majority are edge tokens close to the payment type boundary. No obvious infra-level quantization skew in the quick check.

Aditya — can you confirm kernel rollout status? If infra is clean, I'll prepare a temporary pin plan. My recommendation: 
- Immediate: apply per-tenant pin to redwood-open-7b-q8@v3.0.9 for Peregrine's prod traffic (rolling config, ~30 minutes to stage + 5-10 minutes to flip).
- Fallback: route high-risk flows to redwood-legal-3.1 for 72 hours while we run an expanded blind eval on their 300 labelled rows.

I'll draft the customer text below once Aditya confirms infra. Assigning internal ticket INF-7824 for the work and I'll attach the blind-eval checklist there.

Marissa Cole
